column1: # #1070 flip-path parity manifest. Each fixture is executed through the public
# run-codegen tape -> native artifact) and compared against the Go interpreter
# baseline (default `run` = interp.runFile). Only fixtures that pass on BOTH paths
# are admitted; shapes the Go baseline rejects are out of #1070 scope.
# The first two fixtures are the #1070 PR-1 read-borrow regression (&[]u8 / &i64
# params reached by borrow-expression calls); flip_slice_index is the #1070 PR-2
# element-index regression (b[i] on a []u8); flip_slice_len is the #1070
# std::mem::len(s) regression (length of a str literal / []u8 slice);
# flip_slice_range is the #1070 PR-2b range-slice regression (b[i..j] on a []u8,
# const and variable bounds); flip_deref_read is the #1070 read-deref regression
# (`expr.*` on &i64 / &[]u8 borrow params, the identity dual of the read borrow
# lock a supported subset so the baseline cannot silently drift.
